//: Composite indexes required by this app. Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes, and serves an equality-only conjunction by MERGING them, so two equality filters need no entry here — an earlier version of this note said they did, which is why hoursRequests (coordinatorContact, status) is provisioned while its sibling (orgId, status) in the same Promise.all is not, and both work. What genuinely needs an entry is an equality filter combined with an orderBy on a DIFFERENT field. Without those, the query throws 'The query requires an index' the first time it runs against real data (demo mode never hits Firestore, which is why they pass locally). Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

indexes.//: StudentDashboard: applications where studentId == uid, ordered by appliedAt desc, limit 50
OrgOpportunityApplicants / OrgDashboard: applications for one opportunity, newest first
waitlistService: promote the oldest waitlisted applicant for an opportunity
OrgDashboard: hoursRequests addressed to this coordinator, pending only
StudentOpportunities: is this specific opportunity already saved by this student
StudentDashboard: this student's most recent saves
OrgDashboard: this organization's opportunities, newest first
Developer console: every OPEN safety report, newest first. Without this the queue was 'newest 200', so an unactioned report older than 200 newer ones was unreachable from every screen.
